changes_made.explanation: Minor normalization of model name capitalization. The outputs were refined to be more precise about what is actually generated in the described games.
Normalized 'Merlin Evasion' to lowercase for consistency with other metrics. All metrics are explicitly used to evaluate game performance in the paper.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper - GPT-4 is used only as the main generation model, not for post-hoc evaluation of outputs.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper - all evaluation is based on automatic metrics measuring game performance.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on multi-agent game modeling using LLMs, with evaluation primarily through game performance metrics rather than traditional NLG evaluation. The extracted metadata was generally accurate and required minimal correction.
